scope: Stock-adapted WSF event, critical, wake, dispatch and Apollo radio callback handoff

provenance.classification: reconstruction/adaptation; not unchanged public source or private stock port

verified_stock_effects: Outer-depth critical entry CPSID and final-depth exit CPSIE without saved PRIMASK restoration.
8-bit event coalescing by OR, low-four-bit handler indexing, and task-ready bit publication.
Dispatcher message, timer, then handler ordering; clears event before callback; drains newly posted work.
Message callback followed by message free; timer callback message is not freed by dispatcher.
Task/ISR wake notification branch and PendSV conditions at the external-provider boundary.
Radio GPIO callback set-event handoff through the actual WSF implementation.
material_limits: Context, RTOS notify/wait, queue/message, timer, and app handlers are fixtures; real provider effects and scheduling are unproven.
WSF handler IDs 10–15 alias bytes beyond the ten valid event slots, including queue-control storage; the stock path does not validate them.
Critical enter/exit require balanced nesting and the documented bound; final exit enables IRQs regardless of prior PRIMASK.
Message/timer providers must return valid registered handler IDs; dispatch does not null-check those handlers.
No physical GPIO delivery, RTOS initialization, complete BLE stack boot, or full firmware bundle is established.

accounting_followup.wsf_os_init_native_attempt: INCONCLUSIVE and excluded from pass/execution coverage; corrected static fill/call chain only supports conditional normal initialization path; no runtime boot claim
